name: brand-guidelines-agent
description: Pulls the project's LFX record and runs a research sweep, then guides an LF project leader through a short intake (or pre-fills it in batch mode for ED review) and generates a project Brand Kit document — positioning, voice, audience messaging, competitive guardrails, LFX-derived governance and trademark wording, and a five-component visual identity direction — following the LFX Marketing OS Brand Kit standard.
